name: USC Summer Programs: business courses (Introduction to Business, Exploring Entrepreneurship, and more)
what_you_do: Take one four-week college course. USC teachers and pros teach it. You can pick a business course. Choices include Intro to Business and Exploring Entrepreneurship. Others cover data and green business.
who_can_apply: High school students who have finished at least 9th grade by the start and take a rigorous course load. Domestic and international students may apply.
pay_detail: Prices on the admissions page, shown with the 2027 deadlines: tuition $7,617, materials $300, program fee $350, health center $104. Total $8,371 commuter or $11,946 residential, plus an $85 application fee. A $1,000 deposit holds your seat and counts toward the total. No financial aid is mentioned.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 deadlines: domestic students May 7, 2027 at 12 p.m. PT, international students March 12, 2027 at 12 p.m. PT. The program page says to check back in November 2026 for application information. Decisions are made on a rolling basis.
how_to_apply: Apply online with a 300 to 500 word essay, a teacher, counselor or mentor recommendation, a transcript and the application fee. You can apply for up to three courses but you take one. Join the email update list for 2027 news.
notes: Expensive. The fee table has no year label, so confirm prices when you apply. The pages did not give an age limit.
